visual_text: Aspirin in healthy over-70s: counted by what people could still do
Main outcome: staying alive without dementia or lasting disability
Lost disability-free survival, per 1000 people per year
Serious bleeding over median 4.7 years, per 100 people
Had a heart attack or stroke? Keep taking aspirin unless your doctor advises otherwise.
alt_text: Two bar pairs from the ASPREE trial. Lost disability-free survival per 1000 people a year: aspirin 21.5, dummy tablet 21.2, no clear difference. Serious bleeding over a median 4.7 years per 100 people: aspirin 3.8, dummy tablet 2.8, more bleeding on aspirin. Note: keep taking aspirin after a heart attack or stroke unless your doctor advises otherwise.
design_instructions: Single 4:5 chart card. pairBars (c07_common.js) two groups, separate scales (max 25 each), aspirin solid teal, dummy tablet hatched grey. Badges for verdicts; mint panel with advice. Data: C07-05-b (21.5 vs 21.2 per 1000 person-years), C07-05-c (3.8% vs 2.8%).
